BiblicalUsage: Akan is named in the genealogy of Esau as a son of Ezer, among the Horite chiefs of Seir. He is the Horite Akan, not Achan of Jericho, and his name survives only in the family record of Edom.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Bible keeps Edom's lines as carefully as Israel's, because God is the God of all nations, not only of one.
